messages:
Lia (design): quick check: Resources table causes horizontal scroll on narrow phones (~360px). I'm proposing a swipe-up bottomsheet list at <=420px instead of compressing columns.
Omar (frontend): 👍 bottomsheet is good for actions. How do we handle the persistent top toolbar?
Lia (design): toolbar stays pinned (search + crumbs). We'll reduce toolbar height to 48px and the table becomes the sheet.
Jess (product): filters discoverability concern if moved into sheet.
Omar (frontend): keep a filter pill in toolbar that opens sheet focused on filters.
Alex (pm): keyboard issues — sheet can go under keyboard on iOS.
Lia (design): set sheet max-height = calc(100vh - toolbarHeight - env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) and recompute on resize/keyboard events.
Omar (frontend): implemented similar in other apps. Need iOS WKWebView testing.
Jess (product): header copy: "Resources" ambiguous. Suggest "Workloads".
Lia (design): agree, "Workloads" is concise.
devex-bot: analytics: ~22% of page sessions are <=420px (30d).
Lia (design): accessibility: move focus to sheet, trap focus, visible close button, 44px tap targets.
Omar (frontend): will add aria-modal="true" and inert background, plus a skip link in toolbar.
Jess (product): long IDs should truncate with an inline "Show" toggle (no tooltips).
Lia (design): truncate to 24 chars + expand; screen readers get full text offscreen.
Omar (frontend): plan: prototype by Wed, accessibility review Thu. I'll test keyboard on iOS/Android.
Alex (pm): assign 2d spike to Omar; if OK, mobile canary next sprint.
Lia (design): posting mock later today. @Omar please add prototype link when ready. :thumbsup:
